_comment: All values in SI units (metres, seconds, kg, radians) unless noted. Edit freely to tune balance; see knowledge.md in each package for how each constant is used.

movement._comment: v_max = base + scale*top_speed_attr ; a_max = base + scale*acceleration_attr

kicking._comment: sigma_angle in radians = base + scale*(1 - precision^precision_exponent). power in m/s = base + scale*attr. running_power_coefficient: max run boost = coefficient (at full sprint in line with kick). power_base/scale rescaled from 15/20 so full-sprint run_mult=1.7 gives same peak speed as old coeff=0.3 (run_mult=1.3): factor=1.3/1.7=0.765. running_direction_precision_*: reduce kick precision by up to 75% when kicking against the run direction (backwards). cos_high=0.35 (~70° forward cone), cos_low=-0.2 (~102°), penalty_mid=0.25 at cos_low, penalty_max=0.75 at cos=-1. See design doc for worked tables.

passing._comment: Auto-pace for a grounded pass: v = overshoot_factor * sqrt(2*mu_roll*g*distance), clamped to [min,max]. Error model is now unified with kicking (KickingParams) - sigma scales with both precision and effective power.

goalkeeping._comment: 'Save' action: predicts where an incoming shot crosses the keeper's own goal line and moves the keeper there. See engine/knowledge.md for the crossing-point prediction and the ball-freeze-on-pickup rule that makes saves work with the generic possession model. early_intercept_max_distance_m: GK only attempts early interception when ball is within this range. early_intercept_safety_margin: GK must be reachable at the intercept point in less than this fraction of the time to reach the goal line (guards false positives on fast/far shots).

tackling._comment_speed: tackle_attempt_tackler_speed_mult: tackler speed is immediately multiplied by this on a tackle attempt (0.5 = halved). tackle_attempt_tacklee_speed_mult: same for the tacklee (0.8 = 20% reduction). The loser additionally loses up to loser_speed_penalty_max of their speed, scaled linearly by |winner_roll - loser_roll| * loser_speed_penalty_scale, capped at loser_speed_penalty_max.
tackling._comment_cooldown: tackle_cooldown_s: both tackler and tacklee enter INACTIVE_TACKLED for this duration after a tackle, preventing re-tackle spam. Players can still move and issue other orders during this time.
tackling._comment_angle: Modifier added to tackling boost based on approach angle. angle=0 (frontal, tackler is directly in front of dribbler): +10%; angle=90 (side): -5%; angle=180 (from behind): -65%. Piecewise linear in cos(angle).
tackling._comment_gk_outside: goalkeeper_outside_box_tackle_penalty: fractional reduction applied to effective_boost when a GK makes a tackle outside their own box. Reduces the 2.0 GK boost to ~1.2 — comparable to an outfield tackler, not better.
tackling._comment_control_time: control_time_penalty_reference_s: reference duration used to scale the dribbling penalty for CONTROLLING_BALL players. A player at/above this many seconds remaining gets up to 25% dribbling penalty; near 0s remaining gets no penalty.

control_time._comment: Time (s) for a player to bring a ball under control on first touch. See knowledge.md in engine/ for full derivation. Jump zone (above player_height_m=1.8m): outfield_jump_scale_at_max_reach multiplies the (height_factor-1) term at outfield_max_reach_height_m; GK's height_factor_scale interpolates toward gk jump_scale_at_max_reach at gk_max_reach_height_m.

collision._comment: Player-player velocity damping on overlap. collision_velocity_retention: fraction of closing speed kept per tick (0.5 = 50% reduction). collision_damping_min_closing_speed_mps: closing speeds below this floor are left untouched, preventing unbounded compounding over many ticks of sustained overlap (see design doc for worked example).

repulsion._comment: AI/order-layer steering — used ONLY in steering.py / MoveOrder handling. NOT engine physics. radius_m: distance at which repulsion begins. strength_base: peak directional weight at d=0 (m/s-equivalent, blended into heading not force). ball_carrier_repulsion_mult: extra boost when the moving player has the ball. ball_carrier_speed_penalty_max: max fractional speed penalty for ball carriers (0.4 = 40% reduction). speed_penalty_scale: converts |net_repulsion| to speed penalty fraction. alignment_dot_threshold: trigger orthogonal nudge when rel_vel . net_repulsion < this (i.e. heading nearly straight into obstacle). min_orthogonal_adjust_mps: sideways nudge magnitude (primary tuning knob — start at 1.5, tune via balance test).

marking._comment: MarkOrder AI behaviour: marker stands between a target opposition player and the ball, and switches to GetPossession-style chase/tackle when the target has the ball or the ball comes within mark_intercept_radius_m. mark_standoff_m: distance from the target (toward the ball) the marker tries to hold.

ui._comment: UI-level timing constants. scenario_linger_s: how long (sim-seconds) a scenario trial keeps running after its outcome is determined before the next trial starts. goal_linger_s: how long (sim-seconds) the ball stays in place after a goal before the engine resets it to centre (giving players/GK time to react visually).
